title: Doesn't hold much
text: Doesn't hold much. Attractive and sleek but doesn't even hold two boxes of tea- too small for us

product_metadata.title: RECAPS Tea Bags Coffee Sugar Packets Sweeteners Seasoning Packets Storage Holder Home Kitchen Pantry Cabinet Countertop Organizer Holder Plexiglass
features: 1.It is made of clear acrylic and not breakable. it is food safe. Could be hand washed with mild soap and water; Do not place in dishwasher.

2.This is a nice-looking and long lasting holder for multi-use, such as holding tea bags, sugar packets, sweeteners, honey sticks, flavors, liquid vitamins, stirrers, toothpick or even paper clips, pins, pens and pencils to keep your desk clean and tidy.
3.It is a must gift for anyone who is an obsessive aims to organize/store things perfectly.

4.Size: it is 6.06 inches in diameter and 3.07 inches in height with 5 divided sections - 4 circled the edges and 1 in the middle. Each of the four sections could holds 6-7 tea bags in different tastes separately, and the center one could store sugar packets to be a perfect desk tea bag holder organizer.
5.Item Included: 1 * Tea Bag Holder (Tea Bags Excluded)
